name: Water and wastewater
summary: Treatment plants and distribution networks that need valves to last decades between overhauls.
body: Utilities ask us for three things: certified materials for drinking water, actuators that keep working through a power cut, and parts that are still available twenty years later.
needs: NSF/ANSI 61 materials|Dead-end rated butterfly valves|Actuators with manual override|20-year parts commitment

name: Chemical processing
summary: Corrosive, toxic and high-temperature service where leaks are not acceptable.
body: We publish material compatibility tables for every wetted part, and our engineers review service conditions before quoting a valve for hazardous service.
needs: Fire-safe seats|Live-loaded stem packing|Material test reports|Compatibility review

name: Food and beverage
summary: Hygienic valves and pumps that clean in place and leave no dead space.
body: Sanitary valves are machined from 316L, finished to 20 Ra or better, and shipped with surface finish records.

name: Oil and gas
summary: Midstream and refining service at higher pressure classes.
body: Valves for sour service are built to NACE MR0175 and fire tested to API 607.
needs: NACE sour service|API 607 fire test|Class 300 – 600|Witnessed testing

name: Power generation
summary: Steam, feedwater and cooling water at power plants.
body: Control valves with anti-cavitation trim for feedwater and recirculation lines, and dual-plate checks for cooling water.
needs: Anti-cavitation trim|High-temperature packing|Quick-change trim|Seat leakage Class VI

name: Commercial HVAC
summary: Building services: chilled water, heating hot water and condenser loops.
body: Inline pumps, lug butterfly valves and electric actuators sized for mechanical rooms.
needs: Inline pumps|BACnet-ready actuators|Lug butterfly valves|Submittal packages

name: Pharmaceutical and biotech
summary: Sterile process lines where every wetted surface is documented.
body: Diaphragm and sanitary ball valves with full material traceability, USP Class VI elastomers and drainable bodies.
needs: ASME BPE finishes|USP Class VI elastomers|Full traceability|Drainable bodies
